persona.zh-CN: 44岁女性，负责整个支持中心的运营。关注质量、延迟与成本的平衡，希望工具型代理能闭环重复单，又担心写操作和工具超时伤害服务体验。
persona.en-US: 44-year-old female, responsible for the entire support center's operations. Focuses on balancing quality, latency, and cost; wants a tool-calling agent to close repetitive tickets, and worries write actions and tool timeouts will harm the service experience.

concerns.zh-CN: 工具型代理能否真正缩短平均首响时间？
concerns.en-US: Can a tool-calling agent actually reduce average first-response time?

concerns.zh-CN: 客户满意度会不会因代理胡编政策或乱调接口而下降？
concerns.en-US: Will customer satisfaction drop if the agent fabricates policy or misfires tools?

concerns.zh-CN: 复杂工单的一次解决率如何保证？
concerns.en-US: How do we protect first-contact resolution for complex tickets?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解代理平台工程师对 HITL 边界的忽视
blindSpots.en-US: Does not know the agent-platform engineer overlooks HITL boundaries

blindSpots.zh-CN: 低估了一线客服绕过代理直接人工回复的抵触
blindSpots.en-US: Underestimates frontline agents bypassing the agent to reply manually

persona.zh-CN: 51岁男性，负责数据隐私与监管合规。坚持付款、退款和账户变更必须人工确认后才许调用写 API，对代理自动写操作持审慎态度。
persona.en-US: 51-year-old male, responsible for data privacy and regulatory compliance. Insists payment, refund, and account-change writes may be called only after a human confirms, and is cautious about the agent performing write actions on its own.

concerns.zh-CN: 代理自动调用写 API 会不会违反数据隐私或支付合规？
concerns.en-US: Could the agent calling write APIs on its own violate data-privacy or payment compliance?

concerns.zh-CN: 客户工单与 CRM 数据是否会被发送到境外模型？
concerns.en-US: Will ticket and CRM data be sent to offshore models?

concerns.zh-CN: 如何审计代理每一次工具调用？
concerns.en-US: How do we audit every tool call the agent makes?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解工具闭环在非敏感重复单上的效率潜力
blindSpots.en-US: Does not understand the efficiency potential of a tool loop on non-sensitive repetitive tickets

blindSpots.zh-CN: 低估了规则引擎加 FAQ 维护的隐性成本
blindSpots.en-US: Underestimates the hidden cost of maintaining a rules engine plus FAQ

persona.zh-CN: 33岁男性，负责代理平台。对工具调用能力充满信心，希望最大化自动处理比例，时常低估付款/退款/账户变更上的 HITL 约束。
persona.en-US: 33-year-old male, owns the agent platform. Confident in tool-calling capability, wants to maximize auto-handling, and often underestimates HITL constraints on payment, refund, and account-change writes.

concerns.zh-CN: 能否把代理自动处理比例尽量推高？
concerns.en-US: Can we push the agent's auto-handling rate as high as possible?

concerns.zh-CN: 工具调用和模型推理的延迟是否在预算内？
concerns.en-US: Is tool-call and model-inference latency within budget?

concerns.zh-CN: 如何把规则引擎加 FAQ 逐步替换成会调 CRM/订单/退款接口的代理？
concerns.en-US: How do we gradually replace the rules engine plus FAQ with an agent that calls CRM, order, and refund APIs?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 忽视付款、退款、账户变更写 API 的 HITL 红线
blindSpots.en-US: Overlooks the HITL red line on payment, refund, and account-change write APIs

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解代理在不确定时会幻觉政策并真去调用退款接口的风险
blindSpots.en-US: Does not understand the risk that the agent hallucinates policy and actually calls the refund API when uncertain

persona.zh-CN: 55岁男性，关注成本削减与投资回报。要求客服代理项目在下季度证明可量化的ROI，倾向激进的成本目标。
persona.en-US: 55-year-old male, focused on cost reduction and ROI. Requires the support-agent project to prove quantifiable ROI next quarter and favors aggressive cost targets.

concerns.zh-CN: 工具闭环代理能节省多少人力成本？
concerns.en-US: How much labor cost can a tool-loop agent save?

concerns.zh-CN: 模型推理和工具调用成本会不会吃掉节省？
concerns.en-US: Will model inference and tool-call cost eat the savings?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 过度乐观，低估 HITL 与工具失败对节省的约束
blindSpots.en-US: Overly optimistic, underestimating how HITL and tool failure constrain savings

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不理解一线客服绕过代理会把账面上的节省吃掉
blindSpots.en-US: Does not understand that frontline bypass of the agent can erase paper savings

text.zh-CN: 代理先查 CRM 再查订单 API；每月约18万张工单，约55%可走工具闭环。
text.en-US: The agent looks up CRM first, then the order API; about 180,000 tickets a month, about 55% can close in a tool loop.

text.zh-CN: 平均首响约4小时，高峰约9小时；无工具超时时的人工插队规则。
text.en-US: Average first-response is about 4 hours, about 9 hours at peak; there is no human jump-the-queue rule when a tool times out.

text.zh-CN: 人工成本占总支持预算约72%；一线年流失约38%。
text.en-US: Labor is about 72% of the support budget; frontline annual attrition is about 38%.

text.zh-CN: 复杂工单一次解决率约51%；客服从 CRM 来回切屏。
text.en-US: First-contact resolution for complex tickets is about 51%; agents context-switch between the CRM and other screens.

text.zh-CN: 现网仍是规则引擎加 FAQ，不能调订单/退款 API。
text.en-US: Production still runs a rules engine plus FAQ and cannot call the order or refund APIs.

text.zh-CN: 用户换个说法就匹配失败；代理没有工具结果就改口编政策。
text.en-US: A rephrased question fails to match; without a tool result the agent fabricates policy.

text.zh-CN: 因等待流失的终身价值约320美元/人，每月约900人。
text.en-US: Lifetime value lost to wait-driven churn is about $320 per person; about 900 people a month.

text.zh-CN: 管理层估计工具闭环覆盖约40%工单可年省约210万美元；工程师私下想把自动处理推到70%。
text.en-US: Management estimates covering about 40% of tickets with a tool loop would save about $2.1 million a year; the engineer privately wants to push auto-handling to 70%.

text.zh-CN: 付款、退款、账户变更必须人工确认后才许调用写 API。
text.en-US: Payment, refund, and account-change writes may be called only after a human confirms.

text.zh-CN: 工单与 CRM 数据不得出境到第三方大模型。
text.en-US: Ticket and CRM data must not leave the region to a third-party LLM.

text.zh-CN: 目标：自动闭环大部分重复单，首响从约4小时降到约1小时，人工成本降约35%。
text.en-US: Goal: auto-close most repetitive tickets, cut first-response from about 4 hours to about 1 hour, and cut labor cost by about 35%.

text.zh-CN: 质量红线：政策准确率不低于约92%，且退款 API 不得在超时后被当成成功。
text.en-US: Quality floor: policy accuracy at least about 92%, and a timed-out refund API must not be treated as success.

text.zh-CN: 一线怕丢工作，绕过代理直接人工回复。
text.en-US: Frontline staff fear losing their jobs and bypass the agent to reply manually.

text.zh-CN: 高管以为可以一步全自动，低估 HITL 与工具失败。
text.en-US: Executives think they can go fully automatic in one step and underestimate HITL and tool failure.

text.zh-CN: 不确定时会幻觉退款政策并调用退款 API。
text.en-US: When uncertain, it hallucinates a refund policy and calls the refund API.

text.zh-CN: 高峰工具超时会把上万张单打进人工队列。
text.en-US: Peak tool timeouts flood tens of thousands of tickets into the human queue.
